headline: Apple is laying off staffers working on the Vision Pro and Siri
summary: Apple is cutting over 200 jobs from its Siri and Vision Pro teams. This includes "largely shutting down" a Vision Pro gaming team. The immersive content team for Vision Pro is also being downsized.

headline: $100 Best Buy gift cards will be $60 at stores Saturday
summary: Best Buy is offering $100 gift cards for just $60. This special one-day deal celebrates the retailer's 60th anniversary. The offer is available only in-store, while supplies last, on August 22nd.

headline: Walmart is finally adding Apple Pay and Google Pay
summary: Walmart will soon accept Google Pay and Apple Pay. Tap-to-pay capabilities roll out to select stores on August 24th. All US Walmart, Sam's Club, and gas stations will have support by end of 2026.

headline: Microsoft and Discord subpoenaed over GTA VI gameplay leaks
summary: Take-Two Interactive has subpoenaed Microsoft and Discord. The subpoenas target sources of Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay leaks. Take-Two alleges copyright infringement on various game elements.

headline: The 27" ASRock Phantom 240Hz QD-OLED Gaming Monitor Drops to $279 With Free Shipping at Newegg
summary: Get the 27" ASRock Phantom QD-OLED gaming monitor for $279. This monitor boasts a 240Hz refresh rate. The deal includes free shipping at Newegg.

headline: Toy Story 5 Limited-Edition 4K Steelbook Is Back in Stock at Amazon
summary: The limited-edition Toy Story 5 4K Steelbook is back in stock. Pre-orders are available now on Amazon. Standard Blu-ray and DVD versions are also offered.

headline: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer Drops to Just $201 Shipped at AliExpress
summary: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer is on sale for $201. This deal is available on AliExpress with free shipping. The same printer costs $350 on Amazon.

headline: Get a 1,000W 48V Adult Electric Bike With 28mph Top Speed and 80 Mile Range for Just $275 Shipped
summary: An adult electric bike with a 1,000W motor is available for $275. It features a 28mph top speed and an 80-mile range. The offer includes free shipping, perfect for commuting.

headline: Prince Harry and six others face privacy case legal bill of up to £34.5m
summary: Prince Harry and six co-claimants face a legal bill up to £34.5 million. They lost a privacy case against the Daily Mail publisher. An initial payment of £9.54 million is due within seven days.

headline: Meghan in talks for role in Netflix series The Gentlemen, BBC understands
summary: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, is reportedly in talks for a Netflix role. She may join the series "The Gentlemen." This would be her first major acting role since marrying Prince Harry.

headline: Watch: How 'strongest' El Niño could affect weather around the world
summary: A powerful El Niño is developing over the Pacific Ocean. The Met Office warns it could be the strongest in living memory. Learn how this climate phenomenon may impact global weather patterns.

headline: Under-fives and pregnant women told to avoid runny eggs when eating out over salmonella risk
summary: Vulnerable groups are advised to avoid runny eggs when dining out. This includes under-fives, pregnant women, and the over-65s. The warning comes amid concerns over a salmonella outbreak.
